decision_needed.question: The Reclass column (1,290,885) removes the GF-to-Depreciation transfer (599,601) and the General Fund's payments to the Educational Leasing Corp (691,284) from the General Fund function lines. The page with the line-level Total column (report p9) is not trimmed, and p2 shows only function totals. Is it acceptable to keep the printed General Fund lines and book one contra per function (Instruction -50,000, Pupil support -178,001, Support services business -154,000, Maintenance and operations -758,284, Pupil transportation -150,600) instead of reducing individual lines?
decision_needed.recorded_as: Five signed contra disbursement lines from p2 function differences; transfers_in/out 599,601 recorded separately; ELC lease revenue 691,284 and its Reclass (691,284) on row 1990 recorded as an offsetting pair in receipts

decision_needed.question: Should the School Activities Fund (receipts 409,498, disbursements 398,750; p12) and Student Fees Fund (receipts 6,017, disbursements 3,170; p13), which are left out of the district's net position and governmental totals, be included as student activities?

notes: Modified cash basis school district (Washington County School District No. 3). Governmental figures use Total Governmental Funds column (GF, Special Building, Depreciation, Bond, QCPUF, Educational Leasing Corp, net of Reclass column). The first disbursement page's right-hand columns (Total Governmental Funds column for instruction through career education lines, report p9) are not in the trimmed PDF; the printed line amounts for those lines are therefore the General Fund column (p7), except 2900 Other support services 733,050 (Depreciation Fund). The Reclass column (total 1,290,885) removes General Fund payments to the Educational Leasing Corp (ELC) and the GF-to-Depreciation transfer from those function lines; the Statement of Activities (p2) shows the reclass by function, so one signed contra line per function was added (computed from p2: Instruction -50,000; Pupil support -178,001; Support services business -154,000; Maintenance and operations -758,284; Pupil transportation -150,600; total -1,290,885), so each function nets to its Total column figure and disbursements tie to the printed total 13,571,413. Which individual lines carry the reclass is not shown. Debt related costs (row 5000) stays at the full printed 1,672,186: the Reclass column shows '-' on that row and p2 Debt service is 1,672,186 (it includes the ELC's own 691,284 debt payment). ELC lease revenue 691,284 is on row 1990 Miscellaneous local receipts (ELC column 691,284, Reclass (691,284), p6; Total column 3,827); recorded as a printed ELC line plus an offsetting reclass line (net zero), so receipts still tie to the printed total 13,978,141. Business-type = School Lunch Fund (p10-11); USDA and state subsidy 119,480 split 1,955 state / 117,525 federal per budget schedule p21. Activities Funds (p12) and Student Fees Fund (p13) are not in the district's net position or governmental fund totals; skipped entirely (see decision_needed). TRANSFER CROSS-CHECK: Depreciation Fund receives 'Transfers from general fund' 599,601 (p17). The General Fund budget schedule (p15) and statement (p7) show no transfer out; GF disbursement lines (sum 11,854,694) and fund balance roll (2,392,650 + 12,350,919 - 11,854,694 = 2,888,875) show the transfer is hidden inside GF disbursement lines and removed by the Reclass column. Recorded as transfers_in 599,601 / transfers_out 599,601; in detail, a contra expenditure plus other financing -599,601 for General and +599,601 for Depreciation. Interfund loan 39,922 (Bond Fund to QCPUF; codes 9002/9004, printed inside both governmental totals) is not revenue or spending: recorded in transfers_in/transfers_out (with the 599,601 GF-to-Depreciation transfer, total 639,523) and as includes_split on reported_totals; in detail as other financing (-39,922 Bond, +39,922 QCPUF). Beginning cash = governmental funds beginning fund balance 7,013,317 (p9; equals p3 net position beginning); ending cash = governmental total assets/fund balance 7,420,045 (p4, cash + restricted cash + County Treasurer). business_type measure cash; beginning 190,019 and ending 141,085 per p11; business-type receipts total 431,675 per p21 (operating 312,195 + nonoperating 119,480 on p11). Balance sheet uses Statement of Net Position Total column (p1), which includes business-type cash 141,085; no liabilities. GF budget schedule (p14-15, function-level) recorded in detail as the only GF schedule (program lines on p7-8 are basic statement lines); GF budget schedule actuals differ by rounding of 1 from statement (12,350,918 vs 12,350,919; 11,854,693 vs 11,854,694). Public power district sales tax and nameplate capacity tax categorized as other taxes. Debt related costs 1,672,186 (p9) split by fund column using the Bond Fund (p18: principal 650,000, interest 153,914, fees 200) and QCPUF (p19: principal 165,000, interest 11,788) schedules; ELC column 691,284 kept as principal (no split printed). County fines and license fees (code 2110) categorized as fines and forfeitures. Read pages 1-22 of 22
